user.title: Irrigation Maestro
user.description: Let's start with the basics. Only a weather entity is required — you can skip the optional sensors and add them later. After this you'll add your zones one by one.

data_description.weather_entity: Required. A weather.* entity that provides temperature and precipitation forecasts (e.g. Met.no).
data_description.rain_sensor: A sensor reporting today's total rainfall in mm. If empty, rainfall is estimated from the forecast.
data_description.outdoor_temp_sensor: Use a real thermometer instead of the weather entity for the daily temperature maxima.
data_description.line_flow_sensor: A single flow meter (L/min) on the manifold, shared by zones that don't have their own.
data_description.master_valve: A valve or switch (e.g. a pump relay) opened before the first zone and closed after the last.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single instance of Irrigation Maestro is possible.

engine_advanced.title: Engine (advanced)
engine_advanced.description: Weights and thresholds of the watering decision engine. Only change these if you know what you are doing — 'Reset to defaults' restores the field-validated values.

data_description.temp_weights: Five comma-separated weights: day −3, day −2, yesterday, today, tomorrow. Default 0.05, 0.15, 0.3, 0.35, 0.15.
data_description.rain_weights: Four comma-separated weights: today, yesterday, day −2, day −3. Default 0.85, 0.5, 0.2, 0.05.
data_description.forecast_credit_weights: Two comma-separated weights: rain forecast 0–24 h and 24–48 h. Default 0.6, 0.25.
data_description.forecast_credit_cap_mm: Most credit forecast rain can contribute to the budget. Default 5.
data_description.hot_credit_halving_temp_c: At or above this weighted temperature, forecast rain credit is halved (summer storms often miss). Default 30.
data_description.threshold_base_mm: Base rain amount that makes a session skip. Default 3.
data_description.threshold_slope_mm_per_c: How much the skip threshold rises per °C above the knee below. Default 0.5.
data_description.threshold_knee_c: Weighted temperature above which the threshold starts rising. Default 28.
data_description.threshold_max_mm: Upper cap for the skip threshold. Default 6.
data_description.freeze_skip_c: Skip watering when the current temperature is below this (frost risk). Default 2.
data_description.cold_day_skip_c: Skip when today's effective maximum stays below this. Default 10.
data_description.wind_skip_enabled: Also skip watering when the wind is above the speed below. Off by default.
data_description.wind_skip_kmh: Wind speed that triggers a skip when the option above is on. Default 30.
data_description.staged_rain_weight: Forecast-only rain is counted at this fraction (never full weight). Default 0.8.
data_description.stage_commit_minute: Minute of each hour when the ending hour's forecast rain is committed. Default 55.
data_description.daily_rain_cap_mm: Safety cap on the tracked daily rainfall. Default 200.
data_description.hourly_staging_cap_mm: Safety cap on a single hour's estimated rainfall. Default 50.
data_description.season_months: Months in which watering is considered at all. Default March–October. Zones can override this.
data_description.stale_weather_max_h: Hours without a weather update before the data counts as stale. Default 6.
data_description.stale_weather_policy: When weather is stale: 'Water anyway' uses the last known temperature (budget 0); 'Skip watering' skips.
data_description.reset_to_defaults: Discard every value on this page and restore the built-in, field-validated defaults.

error.invalid_time_window: Windows must look like '08:00-10:30', separated by commas.

run_zone.name: Run zone
run_zone.description: Waters one zone now. Decision gates (cadence, budget, season) are bypassed; safety gates still apply.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone id (the zone_id attribute of the zone's entities).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Watering duration in minutes. If omitted, the program curve decides.

run_all.name: Run all zones
run_all.description: Waters every enabled, non-suspended zone now, in the configured order.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone to skip. Omit to skip every zone.

pause.name: Pause
pause.description: Pauses automatic watering for a number of hours.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone to pause. Omit to pause globally.

suspend_until.name: Suspend until
suspend_until.description: Suspends automatic watering until a date and time.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone to suspend. Omit to suspend every zone.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone to resume. Omit to clear the global pause and every zone.

stop_all.name: Stop all
stop_all.description: Closes every valve, cancels the queue and blocks automatic watering for the configured window.

evaluate.name: Evaluate
evaluate.description: Runs one engine evaluation and returns the full watering plan as the response.

set_zone_order.name: Set zone order
set_zone_order.description: Changes a zone's watering priority (zones water in ascending order).

set_curve.name: Set curve
set_curve.description: Replaces a program's watering curve with inline control points.

cycle_id.name: Program
cycle_id.description: The program whose curve is replaced.

points.name: Control points
points.description: List of [temperature, value] pairs with strictly increasing temperatures.

min_value.name: Minimum
min_value.description: Lower clamp. If omitted, the current minimum is kept.

max_value.name: Maximum
max_value.description: Upper clamp. If omitted, the current maximum is kept.

kind.name: Curve output
kind.description: What the values mean: minutes (duration) or litres (volume). Volume needs a usable flow meter. If omitted, the program's current kind is kept.

export_config.name: Export configuration
export_config.description: Returns the hub options and every zone's configuration as a JSON string.

import_config.name: Import configuration
import_config.description: Applies a previously exported configuration to the hub and its existing zones.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: The JSON string produced by export_config.

set_program_schedule.name: Set program schedule
set_program_schedule.description: Sets the days and start time of a program.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone the program belongs to.

days.name: Weekdays
days.description: Used by the "weekdays" mode: 0 = Monday … 6 = Sunday. Empty means every day.

start_time.name: Start time
start_time.description: When it starts, for a fixed-time start.

start_event.name: Sun event
start_event.description: Sunrise or sunset, for a sun start.

start_offset_min.name: Offset (min)
start_offset_min.description: Minutes before (−) or after (+) the sun event.

calendar_mode.name: Calendar mode
calendar_mode.description: How the program picks its watering days: weekdays, every N days, or odd/even. Exactly one mode is active.

interval_days.name: Interval (days)
interval_days.description: Used by the "interval" mode: water at most every N days, counted from the day this program last completed.

parity.name: Odd/even days
parity.description: Used by the "parity" mode: water only on odd or only on even days of the month.

season_months.name: Season (months)
season_months.description: Months this program runs in. Leave empty to follow the hub's season.

set_program_minutes.name: Set program minutes
set_program_minutes.description: Sets a program's watering minutes, either the same every day or per weekday. Not available for volume-target programs.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone the program belongs to.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Same watering minutes every scheduled day. Exclusive with per-day minutes.

day_minutes.name: Per-day minutes
day_minutes.description: Minutes per weekday (0 = Monday … 6 = Sunday), e.g. Monday 15, Wednesday 20. Exclusive with minutes.

add_program.name: Add program
add_program.description: Adds a new program to a zone, optionally copied from an existing one.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone to add the program to.

name.name: Name
name.description: The new program's name. Defaults to 'Program', or the source name followed by ' (copy)' when copying.

copy_from.name: Copy from
copy_from.description: An existing program on the same zone to copy the schedule and curve from.

duplicate_program.name: Duplicate program
duplicate_program.description: Copies a program's schedule and curve into a new program, in the same zone or a different one.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone owning the source program.

target_zone_id.name: Target zone
target_zone_id.description: The zone to create the duplicate in. Defaults to the source zone.

name.name: Name
name.description: The duplicate's name. Defaults to the source name followed by ' (copy)'.

copy_curve.name: Copy curve
copy_curve.description: Copies a program's watering curve into another program. Only the shape moves — name, schedule, calendar, soak settings, enablement and intensity all stay as they are on the destination.

source_zone_id.name: Source zone
source_zone_id.description: The zone owning the program to copy the curve from.

source_program_id.name: Source program
source_program_id.description: The program whose curve is copied.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone owning the destination program.

program_id.name: Program
program_id.description: The program that receives the curve.

remove_program.name: Remove program
remove_program.description: Removes a program from a zone. A zone must keep at least one program.

add_zone.name: Add zone
add_zone.description: Creates a new zone with a default watering program, in place with no reload required. Returns the new zone's id as the response.

name.name: Name
name.description: A friendly name for this circuit, e.g. Vegetable beds or Front lawn.

valve_entity.name: Valve
valve_entity.description: The valve or switch entity that opens this circuit.

area_m2.name: Area (m²)
area_m2.description: Circuit surface, used only to show minutes to mm conversions. Optional.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Icon shown for this zone's device. Leave empty for the default.

update_zone.name: Update zone
update_zone.description: Updates one or more of a zone's settings in place; only the provided fields change.

name.name: Name
name.description: A friendly name for this circuit, e.g. Vegetable beds or Front lawn.

valve_entity.name: Valve
valve_entity.description: The valve or switch entity that opens this circuit.

area_m2.name: Area (m²)
area_m2.description: Circuit surface, used only to show minutes to mm conversions.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Icon shown for this zone's device.

flow_sensor.name: Flow sensor
flow_sensor.description: This zone's own flow meter (L/min). If empty, the shared line meter is used when available.

flow_sensor_unit.name: Flow sensor unit
flow_sensor_unit.description: Only needed when the sensor does not declare a unit, or declares one that cannot be converted. Leave empty to use the unit the entity declares. Set here, it wins over the entity's own unit.

nominal_flow_lpm.name: Nominal flow (L/min)
nominal_flow_lpm.description: Expected flow while watering; enables leak, no-flow and out-of-range detection. Needs a flow meter.

flow_tolerance_pct.name: Flow tolerance (%)
flow_tolerance_pct.description: How far the real flow may stray from the nominal value before it's flagged.

leak_sensor.name: Leak sensor
leak_sensor.description: A binary_sensor reporting that the valve detects a leak. Depending on the hardware this may be a physical probe or an alarm derived from the valve's own flow meter. Leave empty if the valve has none.

water_supply_sensor.name: Water supply sensor
water_supply_sensor.description: A problem binary_sensor for the water supply feeding this zone: on means the supply is missing, off means water is available. Leave empty if there is no such sensor.

adjustment_pct.name: Adjustment (%)
adjustment_pct.description: Scales every watering time up or down. 100 means unchanged.

order.name: Order
order.description: Watering sequence: lower numbers water first.

compatibility_group.name: Compatibility group
compatibility_group.description: Only used when the hub allows more than one concurrent zone. Zones in the same group may run together.

remove_zone.name: Remove zone
remove_zone.description: Deletes a zone and its programs in place, with no reload required.

set_weather_sources.name: Set weather and sensors
set_weather_sources.description: Sets the hub's weather entity and optional shared sensors in place, with no reload required.

weather_entity.name: Weather entity
weather_entity.description: Required. A weather entity that provides temperature and precipitation forecasts.

rain_sensor.name: Rain sensor
rain_sensor.description: A sensor reporting today's total rainfall in mm. Leave empty to clear it; omit to leave it unchanged.

outdoor_temp_sensor.name: Outdoor temperature sensor
outdoor_temp_sensor.description: Use a real thermometer instead of the weather entity for the daily temperature maxima. Leave empty to clear it; omit to leave it unchanged.

line_flow_sensor.name: Line flow sensor
line_flow_sensor.description: A single flow meter (L/min) on the manifold, shared by zones that don't have their own. Leave empty to clear it; omit to leave it unchanged.

line_flow_sensor_unit.name: Line flow sensor unit
line_flow_sensor_unit.description: Only needed when the line meter does not declare a unit, or declares one that cannot be converted. Leave empty to use the unit the entity declares.

master_valve.name: Master valve / pump
master_valve.description: A valve or switch opened before the first zone and closed after the last. Leave empty to clear it; omit to leave it unchanged.

set_consumption_budget.name: Set consumption budget
set_consumption_budget.description: Sets the hub's monthly water cap and what happens once it is exceeded, in place.

liters_per_month.name: Monthly budget (liters)
liters_per_month.description: Total liters allowed per calendar month. Omit or set to zero to disable the budget.

action.name: Action when exceeded
action.description: What happens once the budget is used up: notify only warns, reduce shortens every program, suspend stops watering until next month.

reduce_pct.name: Reduction percentage
reduce_pct.description: By how much each program is shortened when the action is reduce watering.

set_restrictions.name: Set restrictions
set_restrictions.description: Sets the hub's calendar watering restrictions in place, with no reload required.

forbidden_windows.name: Forbidden time windows
forbidden_windows.description: Times when watering is not allowed. Empty means no forbidden times. A running program is cut short rather than run into one.

set_session_limits.name: Set session limits
set_session_limits.description: How long a watering session may run and when it must end.

session_max_min.name: Maximum session length
session_max_min.description: Minutes. Anything still queued past this is skipped.

must_finish_by.name: Must finish by
must_finish_by.description: Local time by which the session must end.

wait_free_min.name: Wait for free valves
wait_free_min.description: Minutes to wait for a busy valve before cancelling the run.

manual_block_min.name: Block after a manual stop
manual_block_min.description: Minutes scheduled runs stay blocked after a manual stop.

settle_pause_s.name: Settle pause
settle_pause_s.description: Seconds between one zone closing and the next opening.

sentinel_time.name: Sentinel time
sentinel_time.description: Local time of the daily check that every due program left a trace.

set_valve_safety.name: Set valve safety
set_valve_safety.description: Confirmation timeouts, the watchdog, leak detection and the water-supply gate.

open_confirm_s.name: Open confirmation
open_confirm_s.description: Seconds to wait for a valve to report open.

close_confirm_s.name: Close confirmation
close_confirm_s.description: Seconds to wait for a valve to report closed.

switch_confirm_s.name: Switch confirmation
switch_confirm_s.description: Seconds for switch-backed valves, which report no position.

startup_valve_timeout_s.name: Startup close timeout
startup_valve_timeout_s.description: Seconds allowed for the close-all performed at startup.

watchdog_max_min.name: Watchdog maximum
watchdog_max_min.description: Minutes after which the watchdog force-closes a valve.

leak_action.name: Leak action
leak_action.description: What happens when a leak is confirmed. notify: a notification and a repair notice only. close (default): also one re-close attempt of the master and the implicated valve, which recovers a valve left open by a command that never landed but cannot stop water passing a valve already shut. close_and_block: also refuses to start new cycles for the zones concerned while the leak lasts.

leak_threshold_lpm.name: Leak threshold
leak_threshold_lpm.description: Litres per minute above which flow with every valve closed counts as a leak. Below it is drip and drainage. Zero means any flow at all counts.

leak_confirm_s.name: Leak confirmation
leak_confirm_s.description: Seconds a leak must be reported before it is believed. The flow source counts only the seconds its meter actually measured; the valve's own sensor counts wall-clock time since the later of the sensor asserting and that valve reporting closed.

leak_repeat_min.name: Leak reminder interval
leak_repeat_min.description: Minutes between reminders while a leak persists. One notification on the transition, then a reminder at this interval; zero turns the reminders off without touching the alarm.

require_water_supply.name: Require the water supply
require_water_supply.description: Refuse to start a cycle for a zone whose water-supply sensor reports no water. With no water the cycle waters nothing anyway, so blocking costs the garden nothing.

water_supply_confirm_s.name: Water-supply confirmation
water_supply_confirm_s.description: Seconds the supply must have been reported missing before a cycle start is refused, so that a single flaky reading cannot withhold water. It does not delay the diagnosis of a cycle the zero-flow guard has already interrupted, which names the missing supply straight away. After a restart the clock starts again, because how long the water has been gone is not knowable.

set_concurrency.name: Set concurrency
set_concurrency.description: How many zones may water together, and master valve timing.

max_concurrent.name: Zones at once
max_concurrent.description: How many zones may water simultaneously.

compatibility_groups.name: Compatibility groups
compatibility_groups.description: Comma-separated group names whose zones may run together.

master_pre_open_s.name: Master pre-open
master_pre_open_s.description: Seconds the master valve opens before a zone.

master_post_close_s.name: Master post-close
master_post_close_s.description: Seconds the master valve stays open after a zone.

set_notifications.name: Set notifications
set_notifications.description: Enable one event (or several at once) and choose the notify services it calls.

event.name: Event
event.description: Which event to configure. Use either this or Events, not both.

events.name: Events
events.description: Several events to configure with the same settings. Use either this or Event, not both.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether these events notify at all.

services.name: Notify services
services.description: Notify service names, with or without the notify. prefix, e.g. mobile_app_phone. Enabling an event with an empty list is refused: it would look configured and send nothing.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: High adds urgency hints understood by mobile app targets. Defaults to high for watchdog, anomaly, sentinel, interrupted and leak.

set_program_advanced.name: Set program advanced options
set_program_advanced.description: Cycle-and-soak and the volume safety timeout.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone the program belongs to.

soak_max_run_min.name: Maximum run length
soak_max_run_min.description: Minutes. Splits the watering so the soil can absorb between runs.

soak_pause_min.name: Soak pause
soak_pause_min.description: Minutes between runs. Needs a maximum run length to have any effect.

volume_safety_timeout_min.name: Volume safety timeout
volume_safety_timeout_min.description: Minutes after which a volume-target run stops regardless.

test_notification.name: Send a test notification
test_notification.description: Sends a test message to the chosen notify services and reports, for each one, whether it went through.

services.name: Notify services
services.description: Recipients to test, with or without the notify. prefix.

event.name: Event
event.description: Shape the test like this event, so a high-priority event is tested with its urgency hints.

notification_status.name: Notification status
notification_status.description: Reports which events notify, which recipients they reach, which recipients no longer exist, and whether the system is mute.

discover_zone_sensors.name: Discover zone sensors
discover_zone_sensors.description: Reports the leak and water-supply sensors already configured for a zone, plus any matching sensor found on its valve's own device. A found sensor is only a suggestion; it takes effect only once saved with update_zone.

weather_unavailable.title: Weather data unavailable
weather_unavailable.description: The weather data could not be fetched at evaluation time. The configured stale-weather policy was applied. Check the weather integration and the configured weather entity.

close_failed.title: Valve did not close
close_failed.description: The valve {entity_id} did not confirm closure after a retry. The watchdog keeps trying; if water still flows, close the supply manually and check the valve hardware.

valve_unreachable.title: Valve unreachable
valve_unreachable.description: The valve {entity_id} has been unavailable for too long. Zones using it cannot water; check its power and radio connection.

sentinel_missing_outcome.title: Scheduled watering did not run
sentinel_missing_outcome.description: No outcome was recorded today for: {cycles}. The trigger probably never fired (Home Assistant was off at trigger time, or an unexpected error occurred).

migration_cadence_dropped.title: Watering cadence replaced by the weekday schedule
migration_cadence_dropped.description: These programs had both a weekday schedule and a per-zone "every N days" cadence, which silently cancelled each other out — some of the days you selected never watered. The weekday schedule is now the only one in effect, so they water on the days you chose: {items}.

migration_weekdays_dropped.title: Allowed-days limit no longer applies to some programs
migration_weekdays_dropped.description: These programs water on an "every N days" cadence, which cannot also be limited to specific weekdays. Their cadence is unchanged, but the allowed-days limit no longer applies to them. If you must comply with it, set their calendar to specific weekdays: {items}.

migration_parity_dropped.title: Odd/even day rule no longer applies to some programs
migration_parity_dropped.description: The odd/even day rule was a global restriction; it is now one of the three calendar modes a program can use, and a program can only have one. These programs kept the calendar they already had, so the odd/even rule no longer applies to them. If your local ordinance requires it, set their calendar to odd or even days: {items}.

migration_program_disabled.title: Some programs could never water and were disabled
migration_program_disabled.description: The days these programs were scheduled on were never allowed by the global allowed-days limit, so they never watered. They have been disabled so this is visible rather than silent. Pick days that are actually allowed and enable them again: {items}.

migration_zone_restrictions_dropped.title: Per-zone restrictions were removed
migration_zone_restrictions_dropped.description: These zones carried their own calendar restrictions, which had no interface and could only be set by editing exported configuration. Restrictions are now hub-wide and cover forbidden hours only; watering days are set on each program: {items}.

migration_curve_template_missing.title: Some programs kept a curve preset that no longer exists
migration_curve_template_missing.description: These programs referenced a curve preset that no longer resolves, so the migration could not convert it into an explicit curve and left it untouched rather than guessing a watering duration. Set their curve explicitly: {items}.

migration_day_minutes_dropped.title: Per-day watering minutes were dropped for some programs
migration_day_minutes_dropped.description: These programs had per-day watering minutes, but their curve waters for zero minutes at 25 °C, so the minutes could not be expressed as a percentage of it and were dropped. Set the program's curve, then set the per-day minutes again: {items}.

notifications_enabled_without_target.title: Notifications enabled with no recipient
notifications_enabled_without_target.description: These events are enabled but have no notify recipient, so they look configured and send nothing: {events}. Open Irrigazione → Settings → Notifications and choose a recipient, or disable them.

notifications_silent.title: Irrigation Maestro will not notify you
notifications_silent.description: None of the events an irrigation system should never miss — valve failure, flow anomaly, irrigation not executed, interrupted cycle, water leak — reaches anyone. If the watchdog force-closes a valve or a cycle never runs, nobody is told. Open Irrigazione → Settings → Notifications to set this up.

notify_target_missing.title: Notification recipient no longer exists
notify_target_missing.description: The notify service notify.{service} is configured for the event "{event}" but no longer exists, so that alert is being lost. Open Irrigazione → Settings → Notifications and choose a recipient that exists.

flow_unit_unknown.title: Flow sensor unit unknown
flow_unit_unknown.description: The sensor {entity_id} does not declare a unit of measurement, or declares one that cannot be converted to litres per minute. Its readings are not being used: volume mode and flow anomaly detection are off for it, and consumption falls back to the nominal flow rate. Set the unit explicitly on the zone (or on the line meter) to turn them back on.

flow_unit_override_conflict.title: Flow meter unit override conflict
flow_unit_override_conflict.description: The flow meter {entity_id} is claimed by both zone {first} and zone {second}, with different unit overrides. One meter can only be read under one interpretation, so {first}'s override is being used and {second}'s is ignored. Give both zones the same override, or set the override on the line meter instead of on either zone.

flow_unit_override_conflict_line.title: Zone override disagrees with the line meter's unit
flow_unit_override_conflict_line.description: The flow meter {entity_id} is the shared line meter, but zone {zone} claims it under its own unit override, which disagrees with the hub's own setting for it. The zone's override is being used; set the hub's line meter unit to match, or remove the zone's own override.

flow_unit_corrected.title: Flow readings are converted from another unit
flow_unit_corrected.description: These meters report in a unit other than litres per minute: {sensors}. Their readings are converted to L/min, so measured litres, volume targets and the water totals derived from them are correct. If you upgraded from a version before 3.2.0, the litres those meters recorded back then were read as if they were already L/min and are understated; that history is deliberately not rewritten, because it mixes measured litres with nominal flow × minutes estimates the defect never touched.

consumption_history_restarted.title: Monthly water total restarts from a carried balance
consumption_history_restarted.description: The old monthly consumption counter has been replaced by the per-zone water history introduced in 3.3.0. Its last value has been carried forward once as this period's opening balance: it mixes litres measured through a flow meter with litres estimated as nominal flow × minutes, and it has no day-by-day breakdown. Both limitations resolve themselves at the next period boundary, when the balance expires and the total comes entirely from the per-zone history again.

leak_zone_valve_sensor.title: Possible leak on {zone}
leak_zone_valve_sensor.description: The valve of zone {zone} reports a leak while it is closed. On some valves that sensor is a ground probe; on others (the SONOFF SWV, for one) it is an alarm derived from the valve's own internal flow meter, meaning "water is passing while I am shut". Either way, what is known is that the valve reports water it should not be seeing. Check the valve seat and the line. This notice stays until the sensor reports no leak again, or until it is removed from the zone; the notification is read and forgotten, this is not. Irrigation Maestro can re-close the master and this valve, which recovers a valve left open by a command that never landed, but nothing it does can stop water passing a valve that is already shut. If the leak action is set to "close and block", no new cycle starts for this zone while this notice is present.

leak_zone_flow.title: Possible leak on {zone}
leak_zone_flow.description: The flow meter serving zone {zone} measured water for longer than the confirmation window while every managed valve reported closed. Only Irrigation Maestro can make that check, because only it commanded the closure. Check the valve seat and the line. This notice stays until the meter reports the water has stopped, or until the meter is removed from the zone; the notification is read and forgotten, this is not. Irrigation Maestro can re-close the master and this valve, which recovers a valve left open by a command that never landed, but nothing it does can stop water passing a valve that is already shut. If the leak action is set to "close and block", no new cycle starts for this zone while this notice is present.

leak_system_flow.title: Possible leak in the irrigation system
leak_system_flow.description: A flow meter measured water for longer than the confirmation window while every managed valve reported closed. That meter does not belong to a single zone, so which zone is leaking genuinely cannot be told -- only that the system is losing water. Check the line and each valve in turn. This notice stays until the meter reports the water has stopped; the notification is read and forgotten, this is not. If the leak action is set to "close and block", no new cycle starts for the zones behind that meter while this notice is present.

water_supply_missing.title: No water supply for {zone}
water_supply_missing.description: The water-supply sensor of zone {zone} reports that the water is gone. That sensor has a "problem" device class, so "on" means the problem is present -- no water -- however its name reads. This is not a leak: nothing is escaping, there is simply nothing to water with. Check the tap, the mains pressure and any upstream shut-off. Unless the water-supply requirement has been switched off, no new cycle starts for this zone once the outage has lasted the confirmation window, so that a single flaky reading cannot withhold water; a cycle that starts anyway is interrupted by the zero-flow guard a few minutes later, which then names the missing supply as the reason. This notice goes as soon as the sensor reports water again, or the sensor is removed from the zone.

leak_action_invalid.title: Unrecognised leak action
leak_action_invalid.description: The leak action is set to "{value}", which is not one of notify, close or close_and_block. Irrigation Maestro is using "close" instead, so a leak will be notified, recorded here and followed by one re-close attempt -- but not by the blocking you may have meant to configure. Set the action again in Irrigazione → Settings.

invalid_points.message: Invalid curve points ({error}): temperatures must be strictly increasing and values must not be negative.

min_above_max.message: The minimum must not exceed the maximum.

simple_curve_on_volume.message: Program {cycle_id} waters by volume: its curve sets the target in litres, so the minutes control does not apply to it. Edit its curve instead.

volume_requires_flow.message: Program {cycle_id} measures water in litres, which needs a working flow meter, and this zone does not have one. Give the zone a flow sensor, or change the program to water for a duration in minutes instead.

duration_point_out_of_range.message: Program {cycle_id} waters for a duration in minutes, and a duration point cannot exceed a day (1440 minutes). A volume curve, in litres, has no such limit.

invalid_payload.message: The payload is not a valid exported configuration.

unknown_import_zone.message: The payload references a zone that does not exist: {zone_id}.

start_time_required.message: A fixed-time start needs a start_time (HH:MM).

start_event_required.message: A sun start needs a start_event (sunrise or sunset).

cannot_scale_zero_curve.message: Program {cycle_id} waters for zero minutes at 25 °C, so it cannot be scaled to a target. Edit its curve instead.

cannot_remove_last_program.message: A zone must keep at least one program.

calendar_field_required.message: The {mode} calendar mode needs its own field: interval_days for "interval", parity for "parity".

calendar_weekdays_empty.message: A weekday calendar needs at least one day, otherwise the program would never water.

calendar_interval_below_one.message: The interval must be at least one day.

calendar_unknown_parity.message: The parity calendar mode needs "odd" or "even".

soak_pause_without_max_run.message: A soak pause needs a maximum run length: without one the run is never split, so the pause would do nothing.

notify_enabled_without_target.message: The event "{event}" cannot be enabled with no notify recipients: it would look configured and send nothing. Choose at least one recipient.

invalid_notify_service.message: "{service}" is not a valid notify service name. Use the service name, for example mobile_app_phone.
